rounds.text: Setco Automotive Ltd presents a compelling fundamental momentum story backed by robust top-line and bottom-line expansion, with 5-year and 3-year compounded sales growth registering at 18% and 15% respectively [E13, E14], alongside a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 100% [E18]. Capital efficiency metrics stand out strongly against sector benchmarks, featuring a ROCE of 22.04% compared to the sector median of 12.47% [E9], and a solid operating cash flow generation of Rs 234 Cr in March 2026 [E28] that represents 244% of operating profit [E30]. Market participation is supported by powerful technical momentum, highlighted by a relative-strength rating of 100 [E40], a 121.7% twelve-month price return [E41], and a rules-based screen score of 90 out of 100 signalling a medium-confidence buy [E51]. Furthermore, the broader macro environment provides a supportive tailwind with the Automobile & Auto Components sector registering a tailwind score of +1.06 [E59]. The company's balance sheet is heavily burdened by ₹ 1,070 Cr in borrowings [E32] and an alarming ₹ 732 Cr in contingent liabilities [E49], which compounds the risk of its low interest coverage ratio [E48]. Furthermore, promoters have pledged a massive 71.3% of their holdings [E50], signaling intense financial strain and potential vulnerability for key insiders.
